## Which Aviron Treadmill Deal Is Best?


The three treadmills are built for different jobs, so match the machine to how you train and treat the size of the discount as a bonus.


Justice, Podium and Summit, left to right. All three are on sale.


- **Justice ($1,949, save $650):** the walker's treadmill. It climbs to 15% and reaches 12.5 mph on a 3.5 CHP brushless motor, then folds upright with SafeLift. Pair it with the[WalkDesk](https://www.avironactive.com/shop/aviron-walkdesk/) (also on sale) and you can walk through your workday.
- **Podium ($2,449, save $800):** the runner's treadmill. You get 18% incline, 14 mph, a 4.5 CHP brushless motor and a 22" x 60" deck, and it still folds.
- **Summit ($2,849, save $1,150):** the climber. It goes from a 6% decline to a 42% incline, with incline and speed keys on the hiking handles and Aviron's biggest deck. It doesn't fold, and it needs headroom: add 30 inches to your height to find the ceiling you'll need.

## Is the Strong Series Rower Worth It on Sale?


If you want one machine for cardio and strength, yes. Rowing works about 86% of your muscles in one low-impact motion, and the Strong Series Rower's air and magnetic resistance runs from roughly 1 to 100 lb, so it handles an easy warm-up and a hard strength session equally well.


It fits users up to 6'8" and 507 lb and stands upright when you need the floor back. At $1,799 ($700 off), it's also the lowest-priced cardio machine in the sale. It's in stock and ready to ship, which helps if it's a gift.


One membership covers the whole household, with a profile and stats for everyone.

## Which Exercise Bike Deal Should You Choose?


Both Fit Bikes are $600 off and both use electromagnetic resistance. The difference is how they ride:


- **Fit Bike S ($1,899):** a belt drive keeps it very quiet, and a wider stance and low step-through frame make it easy on hips and knees. It fits riders from 4'10" to 6'8", so it's the better pick for shared homes and early mornings.
- **Fit Bike Touring Edition ($2,099):** a chain drive and a narrower, more athletic stance give it the feel of a road bike. It fits riders from 5'1" to 6'8" and suits people who also ride outside.

## Is a Black Friday Fitness Deal Actually Worth It?


Aviron builds game psychology (points, streaks, levels and live races) into its coached classes, scenic routes and science-backed games, so there's always a reason to come back for the next workout. It's a big reason **92% of Aviron members are still working out a year later** . In the 1,062-person[BE ACTIVE trial](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/38583084/) , a behaviorally designed game raised daily steps by about 538 over a year compared with a control group, roughly what paying people did.


Before you buy any Black Friday fitness deal, ask four questions:


- If the price drops next week, do you get the difference back? Aviron refunds it through November 30.
- What does it cost once you add the membership and delivery? Aviron ships machines free to the contiguous US, and the membership is optional.
- Can you send it back? Aviron's 30-Day Risk-Free Home Trial lets you test it at home. Keep the box, because returns need the original packaging.
- How long is the warranty? Aviron machines get a 20-year limited warranty when you activate a membership within 90 days and keep it active. Otherwise, the standard warranty covers the frame (and treadmill drive motor) for 10 years and other parts for 1 year.


Our guide to[ways to save on an Aviron](https://www.avironactive.com/blog/ways-to-save-on-aviron/) covers financing and HSA/FSA in more detail.

## Frequently Asked Questions


### When does the Aviron Black Friday sale end?


Black Friday pricing is live now, and Aviron guarantees it through Cyber Monday, November 30, 2026. If your machine's price drops before then, Aviron refunds the difference, as long as you claim it by December 7. The guarantee excludes accessories or memberships bought alone, financing, gifts and add-ons.


### Does every machine come with a free heart rate monitor?


Yes. Every rower, treadmill and bike in the sale comes with a free Aviron Pulse (normally $89). It tracks your heart rate, blood oxygen and calorie burn in real time, connects over Bluetooth and ANT+, and lasts up to 60 hours per charge.


### Can I use HSA/FSA money or financing on sale prices?


Yes. Aviron machines are HSA/FSA eligible through Truemed, so you can pay with pre-tax dollars (here's[how HSA and FSA differ](https://www.avironactive.com/blog/hsa-vs-fsa-fitness-equipment/) ). You can also spread the cost with Affirm, which offers 0% APR financing subject to eligibility, with your exact terms shown at checkout.


### Can I combine the military or healthcare discount with the sale?


No. Aviron's service discount for military, healthcare workers and first responders is a one-time code, and it can't be combined with other offers, including Black Friday pricing. Use whichever saves you more.


### Do I need a membership?


No, it's optional. Without one, you still get workout tracking and live metrics. The Family Membership unlocks[Aviron World](https://www.avironactive.com/workouts/) : science-backed games, coached classes, scenic routes and live races, with unlimited profiles. It's $29 a month billed annually (monthly billing is available), and nothing is charged until you activate it on your machine. You'll also need an active membership to keep the 20-year warranty.


### What if I don't like it?


If it's your first Aviron machine and you live in the contiguous US, you're covered by the 30-Day Risk-Free Home Trial. Send it back within 30 days of delivery, in its original packaging.
